Q: odoo node in n8n both in saas mode A:

They've improved since then, including more customizable nodes for connecting to Odoo. However, I think it's better to use the more flexible NodeCode, because Odoo nodes have problems extracting data from a key. For example, from the sales model, if I want to know the salesperson's employee (employee_id), it returns something like "Fulano X, 6" --- where 6 is the database position, and there are other similar cases...

Q: How to create certificate authority certificate with makecert? A:

Two of the best and simple help pages:

  • Make your own SSL Certificate for testing and learning
  • Creating self signed certificates with makecert.exe for development

Some examples:

certmgr.exe -add -all -c "benperkmeCA.cer" -s -r localMachine Root

makecert -pe -iv benperkmeCA.pvk -n "CN=benjamin-perkins.me" -eku 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1 -ss my -sr localmachine -sky exchange -ic BenperkmeCA.cer IIS-ServerCert-Benperk.cer
